name: Slaying Sprint
body:
Source Rival Guide pg. 11
With swift feet and deadly intent, you finish off your target before anyone sees your blade.

Prerequisites: Dodge, Mobility, Spring Attack, base attack bonus +13.

Benefit: You can move up to half your speed instead of taking a 5-foot step when taking a full-round action to perform a coup de grace. Performing a coup de grace does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

You can use this feat only when wielding a light or onehanded weapon.
